from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's financial record extracted from a single document."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company this record belongs to")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the financial metric as written in the document")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the metric")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., '2024 年第一季度')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[FinancialRecord]
